title: 3-Tier Corner glass shelf 8-Inch x 8-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Hardware, Foxtrot Collection Allied Brass
description:
Add storage and organization to unused corners with a 3-tier corner glass shelf featuring solid brass hardware and thick tempered glass. This wall-mounted corner shelf (glass shelf for bathroom, vanity corner shelf) keeps items within reach while saving floor space. Designed to coordinate with the foxtrot collection and matching foxtrot accessories, it complements textured bathroom hardware, designer bathroom hardware, and statement bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Three-tier corner shelf creates vertical storage for bath essentials
- 3/8-Inch thick tempered glass with beveled edges
- Crafted from solid brass materials
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean installation
- Installation hardware included; no assembly required

Specs:
- Overall size: 8-Inch L x 8-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Glass thickness: 0.39 in
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Includes: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
